decision: Complete both audits and document whether a separate declared model experiment is justified. Any model experiment must compare complete original folds against v7 and preserve December.

geometry.historical_policy: Fetch all four period-start snapshots only for airports meeting current exact parking coverage; compare identities and positions. A snapshot is recorded map state, not proof of the operational layout or a constant layout over the month.
geometry.provider: OpenStreetMap contributors via public Overpass API
geometry.route_proxy: Undirected mapped taxiway/taxilane connectivity to any shared-node access for the recorded runway. Exclude runway traversal from graph edges. This is a geometric lower bound, not an actual taxi clearance or live routing claim.
geometry.stand_matching: Only upper-case whitespace-trimmed full ref values; parking_position and passenger gate matches reported separately. Multiple ref locations are ambiguous unless all within 30 metres. No zero stripping, fuzzy matching or inferred stand aliases.

prior_information: V7 is 275.0570 seconds officially; prior aggregate error shares and failed clock/arrival/fallback campaigns are known. Ranking stand counts were inspected label-free before declaration: LFPG 39872 rows/361 distinct stands; LIRF 26899 rows/133 distinct stands.
purpose: Fitting-only LIRF/LFPG source audit and label-free exact stand/geometry coverage; no native model fits or submission.

source_audit.interpretation: Raw clock/label relationships on common fitting rows, not v7 prediction errors. Recurrence across months does not establish prediction improvement. No per-ID rule or broader schedule gate is selected.

user_authorization: User approved proceeding with the proposed reporting audit and small geometry coverage study after the v7 gain review.
